This is equivalent to (p_16(x) ∧ p_13(x)) ∨ (¬p_16(x) ∧ ¬p_13(x)). The natural language statement 'either x neither listens actively nor anticipates the needs of others' only covers the part (¬p_16(x) ∧ ¬p_13(x)). It misses the case where both are true (p_16(x) ∧ p_13(x)).

openai/gpt-5-mini.mistake: Pair 3: The formula uses ¬(p_16 ⊕ p_13), which is equivalent to (p_16 ∧ p_13) ∨ (¬p_16 ∧ ¬p_13). The NL stated only (¬p_16 ∧ ¬p_13) as the first disjunct. So the FOL allows both-listens-and-anticipates as well as neither-listens-nor-anticipates, while the NL intended only the latter.
